name: Boggart

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Humanoid. You are also considered a goblinoid for any prerequisite or effect that requires you to be a goblinoid.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were in dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.
rawEntries: You can see in dim light within 60 feet of you as if it were bright light and in darkness as if it were in dim light. You discern colors in that darkness only as shades of gray.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the charmed condition on yourself.
rawEntries: You have advantage on saving throws you make to avoid or end the {@condition charmed} condition on yourself.

traits.name: Fury of the Small
traits.description:
When you damage a creature with an attack or a spell and the creature's size is larger than yours, you can cause the attack or spell to deal extra damage to the creature. The extra damage equals your proficiency bonus.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all expended uses when you finish a long rest, and you can use it no more than once per turn.

traits.name: Nimble Escape
traits.description: You can take the Disengage or Hide action as a bonus action on each of your turns.
rawEntries: You can take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Hide} action as a bonus action on each of your turns.

name: Elf

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
rawEntries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description:
You are part of a lineage that grants you supernatural abilities. Choose a lineage from the Elven Lineages table. You gain the level 1 benefit of that lineage.

When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn a higher-level spell, as shown on the table. You always have that spell prepared. You can cast it once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast it in that way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

You can also cast the spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for the spells you cast with this trait (choose the ability when you select the lineage).

rawEntries.caption: Elven Lineages
rows: The range of your {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} increases to 120 feet. You also know the {@spell Dancing Lights|XPHB} cantrip.

You know the {@spell Prestidigitation|XPHB} cantrip. Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|XPHB}, you can replace that cantrip with a different {@filter cantrip from the Wizard spell list|spells|level=0|class=Wizard}.
Your {@variantrule Speed|XPHB} increases to 35 feet. You also know the {@spell Druidcraft|XPHB} cantrip.

name: Faerie

traits.name: Creature Type
traits.description: You are a Fey.
rawEntries: You are a Fey.

traits.name: Fairy Magic
traits.description:
You know the druidcraft cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast the faerie fire spell with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast the enlarge/reduce spell with this trait. Once you cast faerie fire or enlarge/reduce with this trait, you can't cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

You can also cast either of those spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level.
Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race).

name: Lorwyn Changeling
traitsHtml:
Shape Self.

As an action, you can reshape your body to a two-legged Humanoid shape or to a four-legged Beast shape. While you have a Humanoid shape, you can wear clothing and armor made for a Humanoid of your size.

Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

Delightful Imitator.

You have proficiency in the Deception or Performance skill.

Unpredictable Movement.

When you roll Initiative|XPHB, you can immediately move up to half your Speed|XPHB, provided you don't have Disadvantage|XPHB on the Initiative|XPHB roll.

name: Rimekin
traitsHtml:
Cold Fire Magic.

You know the Ray of Frost cantrip. When you reach character levels 3 and 5, you learn the Ice Knife spell and the Flame Blade spell, respectively. You always have those spells prepared. You can cast each once without a spell slot, and you regain the ability to cast these spells in this way when you finish a Long Rest|XPHB. You can also cast the spells using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. When you cast Flame Blade using this trait, the spell deals Cold damage instead of Fire damage.

Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells (choose the ability when you select this species).

Cold Resistance.

You have Resistance|XPHB to Cold damage.

Darkvision.

You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.
